verdict.rationale: Freshsales' own marketing claims built-in automation of repetitive tasks, so the axis applies and is directly asserted. Nothing in the evidence describes trigger conditions or workflow actions such as record updates, task creation or notifications. The API endpoints are developer building blocks, not a workflow builder, and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented trigger-based workflow builder, explicit field-update, task-creation and notification actions, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Eliminate manual effort and save time by automating repetitive, mundane tasks.
